chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou share a meal, during which Shen Feizhi displays his culinary skills. Shen Feizhi invites Gu Suizhou to a Shen family banquet celebrating Shen Wei's graduation. Gu Suizhou reveals his dark family history: his parents, Lin Zizhuo and Gu Lang, were the heads of the disgraced W.N. Research Institute, which burned down ten years ago. Gu Suizhou suspects the Shen family of foul play regarding his parents' deaths and the disappearance of their remains. The chapter ends with a sudden power outage, during which Gu Suizhou exhibits a sudden, intense psychological reaction, curling into a ball and becoming unresponsive.
